displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists Blip-2 in the Multimodal area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Blip-2: Bootstrapping language-image pre-training with frozen image encoders and large language models”. The page names Junnan Li, Steven Hoi as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
